scientific_integrity.claim: Exact spectrum-by-four-type formula, two zero-free congruence classes with exact valuations, and sharp Gaussian endpoint norm asymptotics for the six-cycle orbit in K_(3,n).
limitations: No classification of all other zero-free n
Priority comparison is bounded and independent audit has not been performed
Six-cycles only, not arbitrary cycles or graphs.

title: Fourier spectrum and zero-free congruence classes of six-cycle orbits in \(K_{3,n}\)
